inj.note: Making his return from a four-game stint on injured reserve due to an ankle sprain suffered on the opening possession of the season, Cooper hit the ground running and finished as the team leader in receptions, receiving yards and targets. The Indiana product also recorded his first NFL touchdown on a 48-yard strike from Geno Smith early in the third quarter, and his instant production despite the layoff gives his fantasy outlook a significant boost heading into a Week 7 home matchup against the Dolphins.

news.h: Jets rookie WR Omar Cooper Jr. to return vs. Patriots; RB Hall, WR Mitchell out
news.d: Jets rookie wide receiver Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) will play against the Patriots, but running back Breece Hall and wideout Adonai Mitchell have been ruled out for Sunday's game.
